title: A2-F1: death saves must apply saving-throw bonuses (Bless, Aura of Protection, Ring of Protection)
description: Second-audit blocker (lane A2, verified by Captain at 6812cc0b). SRD p.98 (rule:death-saving-throws): death saves are 'aided only by spells and features that improve your chances of succeeding on a saving throw. Roll a d20. If the roll is 10 or higher, you succeed.' record_death_save (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRecordDeathSave.ts; state/hpLifecycle.ts:787; state/encounterCombatants.ts:2668/2691) accepts only the natural d20 and compares it to 10; there is no way to apply a save bonus, and nothing else writes death-save counters. A Blessed character rolling natural 9,9,9 dies in the engine but is stable under the SRD (A2 probe /tmp/a2-audit/probes/p01-death-save.ts). Both the character and player-character-combatant paths are affected. The capability declaration (deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts record_death_save) does not disclose the exclusion. Natural 1/20 semantics must stay keyed to the natural roll.
design: 2026-11-05 DESIGN (Captain). Add an optional integer input saveBonus (default 0, bounded -20..+20, integer only; anything else refused before mutation) to record_death_save, plus optional bonusSources: string[] (non-empty strings, max 8) naming the spells/features (e.g. Bless d4 already rolled via roll, Aura of Protection, Ring of Protection). Judging order, both paths (state/hpLifecycle.ts recordDeathSave ~l.787 and state/encounterCombatants.ts resolveCombatantDeathSave ~l.2668/2691): natural 1 -> two failures; natural 20 -> existing revive rule; otherwise success iff roll + saveBonus >= 10. Natural 1/20 never depend on saveBonus. Record saveBonus/bonusSources in the existing provenance/event payload. Update toolRecordDeathSave.ts description and schema, and deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts record_death_save operation/requiredInputs/exclusions/residual (DM decides which effects apply and rolls their dice through roll; the tool does not discover bonuses itself). Tests next to existing hpLifecycle/encounterCombatants death-save tests: Bless natural 9 + 1 succeeds; natural 1 with +10 is still two failures; natural 20 with -5 still revives; malformed saveBonus (string, 1.5, 21) refused with no state change; combatant path parity. Keep record_death_save's SRD text check (rule:death-saving-throws, p.98). Implementer: Haiku 5.5.
acceptance_criteria:
- Death saves succeed on natural d20 + applicable saving-throw bonuses >= 10 for both character and combatant paths.
- Natural 1 (two failures) and natural 20 (revive to 1 HP, subject to existing blocks) are judged on the natural roll alone, independent of the modified total.
- The bonus input is bounded and recorded (provenance); the tool description and capability declaration state it truthfully.
- Regression evidence covers bonus success, natural 1 and 20 with bonuses that would otherwise change the outcome, and refusal of malformed bonus input.
notes:
